zh.title: 史瓦帝尼政府A340專機由桃園轉場高雄　訪臺期間安排航機保養
zh.summary: 史瓦帝尼政府A340專機3DC-SDF今日由桃園機場轉場高雄機場，預計在臺停留期間保養。該機前身為中華航空B-18802，此次搭載史國國王及訪團來臺參加國慶並進行國是訪問。
body: 史瓦帝尼王國政府一架Airbus A340-313X專機於今（14）日中午自桃園國際機場（TPE）起飛，轉場前往高雄國際機場（KHH），預計在臺停留期間進行航機保養。公開航班追蹤資料顯示，該機於台北時間下午12時05分起飛，原預計下午1時24分抵達高雄。
這架專機此次來臺，主要是搭載史瓦帝尼國王恩史瓦帝三世、祖瑪王妃及隨行訪團參加我國國慶慶典並進行國是訪問，同時利用訪臺期間安排航機保養。外交部資料顯示，訪團於10月9日至17日停留臺灣，此行是恩史瓦帝三世自1986年即位以來第20次率團訪臺。
執飛航機註冊編號為3DC-SDF，製造序號406，目前由史瓦帝尼政府使用，主要執行王室及政府外訪任務。該機型採用4具CFM International CFM56-5C4發動機，具備執行長程航線的能力。
3DC-SDF與臺灣航空業淵源深厚，前身為中華航空B-18802，於2001年交付華航，2015年退出營運並飛往美國封存。史瓦帝尼王國於2016年購入該機，經過約兩年的整修及行政專機改裝後，於2018年正式交付史國政府使用。相關資料顯示，該機的技術訓練及維修支援長期與臺灣航空維修體系保持聯繫，大型檢修亦會安排返回臺灣進行。
A340-300是空中巴士研製的四發動機廣體客機，過去曾廣泛用於長程國際航線。隨著航空公司逐步改用油耗較低的雙發動機廣體客機，目前仍在全球執行任務的A340-300數量已明顯減少。3DC-SDF此次由桃園轉場高雄進行保養，也使這架具有華航歷史的史瓦帝尼政府專機再度受到臺灣航空攝影愛好者關注。

en.title: Eswatini Government A340 Repositions From Taoyuan to Kaohsiung for Maintenance During Taiwan Visit
en.summary: Eswatini government A340 3DC-SDF, formerly China Airlines B-18802, repositioned from Taoyuan to Kaohsiung today for planned maintenance during a royal delegation's National Day and state visit to Taiwan.
body: An Eswatini government Airbus A340-313X departed Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) around midday today, October 14, to reposition to Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH), with aircraft maintenance planned during its stay in Taiwan. Public flight-tracking data recorded departure at 12:05 Taipei time and initially estimated arrival in Kaohsiung at 13:24.

The aircraft came to Taiwan carrying King Mswati III of Eswatini, Inkhosikati Make Zuma and their accompanying delegation for National Day celebrations and a state visit, with maintenance also arranged during the visit. Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that the delegation's visit runs from October 9 to 17. This is the king's 20th visit to Taiwan since his accession in 1986.

The aircraft is registered 3DC-SDF and carries manufacturer serial number 406. It is used by the Eswatini government primarily for royal and government overseas visits. The aircraft has four CFM International CFM56-5C4 engines and is capable of long-haul operations.

3DC-SDF has longstanding ties to Taiwan's aviation industry. It previously operated as China Airlines B-18802, was delivered to the airline in 2001, and left service in 2015 before being flown to the United States for storage. Eswatini purchased the aircraft in 2016. Following approximately two years of refurbishment and conversion for government transport, it was delivered to the country's government in 2018. Published accounts indicate that its technical training and maintenance support have retained links with Taiwan's aircraft maintenance sector, with major maintenance also arranged in Taiwan.

The Airbus A340-300 is a four-engine widebody aircraft that was once widely used on long-haul international services. As airlines have increasingly adopted more fuel-efficient twin-engine widebodies, the number of A340-300s still operating worldwide has declined markedly. The repositioning of 3DC-SDF from Taoyuan to Kaohsiung for maintenance has again drawn the attention of aviation photographers in Taiwan to this former China Airlines aircraft.
